svg.title: Where the money stops: $100 of Medicaid and the seven cuts of P.L. 119-21
svg.desc: A vertical column showing $100 of Medicaid spending narrowing as it passes four phases. At state agency, $98.75 remains in FY2030 against $100.00 in FY2024. At disbursements, $84.47 remains in FY2030 against $92.73 in FY2024. At claims to providers, $79.32 remains in FY2030 against $87.07 in FY2024. At beneficiaries, $78.33 remains in FY2030 against $86.92 in FY2024. The seven cuts of P.L. 119-21 are Provider tax limits, $1.25, carried by state budgets; Everything else, $1.06, carried by enrollees; Work reporting, $4.11, carried by people who will not enroll; Six-month renewals, $0.75, carried by people who will not renew; Medicaid enrollment rule suspended, $1.04, carried by people who would have had a paid claim; Directed payment caps, $0.85, carried by hospitals, nursing facilities, academic centres; Medicare Savings rule suspended, $1.28, carried by dual eligibles. Gross removal is $10.34; overhead falls by $1.74; $8.60 less reaches care.
